images.title: The Last Lantern
images.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: Original premium colored manhwa comic page for ManhwaHub demo reader and crop-able book cover.
Create ONE finished portrait comic PAGE, 1024x1536 pixels, with EXACTLY THREE vertically stacked cinematic panels. Elegant narrow cream-white gutters. Original characters only.
Story: The Last Lantern. Young adult courier with dark hair wearing a navy jacket discovers a glowing amber lantern in a rain-soaked teal futuristic city. Top panel: striking cinematic medium portrait of the courier among teal city towers, reflective raindrops, contemplative expression. Middle panel: discovers and lifts warm amber lantern, its magical light reflected in their eyes. Bottom panel: courier holding lantern looking toward an inviting warm glow beyond a rainy city street.
Style: High quality premium colored manhwa illustration, sophisticated beautiful linework, detailed painterly backgrounds, dramatic atmospheric lighting, clear storytelling, strong central focal points suitable for cover cropping.
Include only these English captions, one per panel in simple readable clean white caption boxes. Exact verbatim text:
Top panel: "The city had forgotten the stars."
Middle panel: "Until one light found me."
Bottom panel: "Someone was waiting beyond the rain."
No title text, watermark, logos, additional words, copyrighted franchises, nudity, gore, or violence. Output only the finished page.
